ABOUT NORTH EAST JET SERVICES

Your local ground partner for international operators.

North East Jet Services (NEJS) provides professional ground handling and aviation support for private and business aviation movements throughout Malaysia.

We understand that operators need more than a ramp presence. They need accurate coordination, quick communication, reliable manpower, local operational knowledge and a handler who takes ownership from arrival preparation through departure.

Our team coordinates with operators, flight departments, airport stakeholders, service providers and crew requirements to keep each movement organised and efficient.

OUR SERVICES

End-to-end ground support.

Tell us your aircraft, airport, movement details and requirements. We coordinate the ground-side support.

Ramp Handling

Aircraft arrival/departure coordination, ramp support, chock and marshalling.

Pushback & Tow

Pushback and towing coordination subject to airport and equipment availability.

Passenger & VIP

Meet & greet, passenger assistance, VIP movement coordination and terminal support.

Baggage Handling

Loading, unloading and coordination of baggage requirements for crew and passengers.

CIQ Coordination

Passenger and crew immigration, customs and quarantine coordination where applicable.

Lavatory & Water

Aircraft servicing coordination for lavatory and potable water requirements.

Flight Operations

Permit, overflight and landing permit coordination plus local operational support.

Transport & Catering

Ground transportation and in-flight catering coordination based on movement requirements.
